evidence.note: The September 2024 paper reports a pooled 26.08% output gain, consistent with moderate gains relative to tenfold. This estimate is not exclusive to junior developers.
The report was publicly available before the statement and finds no meaningful efficiency improvement in its sample. Its bug findings do not establish the unscored possible long-term costs.

This contemporaneous experiment reports a substantial task-time benefit, qualifying any suggestion of uniformly small gains. It remains well below tenfold and does not measure overall workplace productivity.

reviews.rationale: The contemporaneous studies support limited or moderate measured gains relative to tenfold productivity. The substantial task-specific benefit in e3 does not overturn that comparative assessment. Different productivity measures remain distinct, and the possible security and technical-debt costs receive no outcome verdict.
